selection.rule: highest B successes, lexicographic arm name breaks ties

audit_checks.checks: Inventory hashes for read originals, step/loss/cost log consistency, plan/corpus/model identities, exact JSON structure results, semantic/step receipt hashes, raw generation consistency, artifact byte readback, failure-state feedback continuity, frozen B/model/C selection bindings

headline: Seven actual LoRA training processes changed parameters; final-answer SFT scored 2/4 on development B but every E1 arm scored 0/3 on development C. E2 produced 63 model calls, one semantically wrong JSON artifact write and zero student semantic successes.
limitations_and_interpretation: All B/C task records are authored development probes on exposed repository artifacts. The confirmation label is a consumption position, not independent custody or new users.

Final-answer SFT produced valid JSON on all four B and all three C tasks; B semantic errors were failed=1 rather than 0 and unverified=537 rather than 1. C arithmetic/shape answers were wrong despite valid JSON.

E1 trajectory C includes duplicated explanatory output and schema/instruction echo. E2 has 62/63 outputs at the 48-token generation cap. Cap contact is observed; why each generation stopped is not independently attributed to the cap versus other stopping causes.
E2 A controlled collection had 14 invalid JSON attempts and zero applied artifacts. Its 14 positive correction records are deterministic-reference supervision, not 14 successful student tasks.
E2 B had 24 invalid attempts and zero artifact writes. Development C had 17 invalid outputs and one valid but wrong {numerator:1,denominator:4} artifact; its later feedback attempt did not repair it.
Three E2 B scores tie at zero; e2_controlled was selected solely by the frozen lexicographic tie rule. This is not an empirical superiority finding.

Trajectory training repeats the correction as the final target and is evaluated as a single JSON artifact. This documented protocol difference, masked-context differences, tiny data and task shift confound causal comparison of trajectory learning versus answer SFT.

E1 trained arms match 32 steps and 8192 padded positions, but supervised tokens differ (219 versus 609). E2 arms match 32 steps and 16384 padded positions, while actual context tokens and collection calls differ. Do not call this exact total training/inference cost equality.
E2 failure-feedback retries total 28; successful recoveries are zero. No E2 persisted-state cold restoration was executed; fresh model loads and E6 cold tests have different scopes.
